42/* @brief Borrowed view of the latest completed sensor output.
43 * The payload remains valid until this sensor publishes again, resets, is initialized again, or is
44 * destroyed. SensorGraph execution and borrowed reads are externally serialized. */
45struct SensorSample {
46 int64_t captureStep = -1;
47 double captureTime = 0.0;
48 int64_t publishedStep = -1;
49 double publishedTime = 0.0;
50 void const* data = nullptr;
51 int64_t elementCount = 0;
52
53 [[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API Span<float const> Floats() const;
54};

69/* @brief Base class for synchronous source and derived sensor nodes. */
70// NOLINTNEXTLINE(cppcoreguidelines-virtual-class-destructor)
71class MOCHI_API SensorBase : public ComponentBase {
72 public:
73 /* @brief Bind fixed graph inputs and prepare immutable output storage. */
74 void Init(Span<SensorBase const* const> inputs, SensorScope const& scope, superdex::Error& error);
75
76 /* @brief Clear the published sample, then reset sensor-specific episode state. */
77 void Reset() final;
78
79 /* @brief Advance this sensor after one physics or hardware step. The returned state
80 * is meaningful only while @p error is OK. */
81 [[nodiscard]] virtual SensorStepResult Step(StepTime const& now, superdex::Error& error) = 0;
82
83 [[nodiscard]] SensorFormat const& GetFormat() const {
84 return _format;
85 }
86
87 /* @brief Initialization-time publication-rate estimate [Hz]; zero means unknown.
88 * Derived nodes inherit the fastest input estimate when all input rates are known. */
89 [[nodiscard]] virtual double GetPublicationFrequencyHzEstimate() const;
90
91 /* @brief Return the latest sample without triggering acquisition or allocation. */
92 [[nodiscard]] SensorSample Latest() const {
93 return _latest;
94 }
95
96 /* @brief Copy the latest flat payload for owning API and language-binding boundaries. */
97 [[nodiscard]] DynamicArray<real> CopyLatestValues() const;
98
99 /* @brief Set the episode seed of this sensor's random streams, if it draws any. Apply before the
100 * graph's Reset(). It overrides the params' `random.episodeSeed` and survives SetParams. */
101 void SetEpisodeSeed(uint64_t episodeSeed) {
102 _episodeSeed = episodeSeed;
103 }
104
105 /* @brief Query optional sensor-specific metadata by a stable library-owned key.
106 * The bytes are an opaque borrowed view of one live producer-owned object, not a wire format.
107 * Interpret them only through TryGetSensorMetadata() while this initialization remains live; do
108 * not copy, persist or deserialize the raw bytes. */
109 [[nodiscard]] virtual Span<std::byte const> TryGetMetadata(std::string_view key) const;
110
111 /* @brief Write constant, sensor-specific recording fields. */
112 virtual void ConfigureRecording(SensorRecordingSink& sink, superdex::Error& error) const;
113
114 /* @brief Write the latest completed sample and any sensor-specific per-sample fields. */
115 virtual void Record(SensorRecordingSink& sink, superdex::Error& error) const;
116
117 /* @brief The sensor's pose relative to its parent frame: the associated link actor for attached
118 * sensors, or the scene root for unattached sensors. Uses the aFromB convention. */
119 [[nodiscard]] TransformRT const& GetParentFromSensor() const {
120 return _parentFromSensor;
121 }
122
123 /* @brief Set the parent-from-sensor transform using the aFromB convention. */
124 void SetParentFromSensor(TransformRT const& parentFromSensor) {
125 _parentFromSensor = parentFromSensor;
126 }
127
128 /* @brief Return the sensor pose in world space.
129 * Attached actors are already world-resolved. For an unattached sensor, parentFromSensor is the
130 * scene-root-to-sensor transform and the scene-root-to-world transform is currently identity. */
131 [[nodiscard]] TransformRT GetWorldTransform() const;
132
133 protected:
134 /* @brief Construct an attached sensor. Sensors that require an actor validate it themselves. */
135 SensorBase(Actor* actor, superdex::Error& error);
136
137 /* @brief Construct an unattached node such as a fusion sensor. */
138 explicit SensorBase(superdex::Error& error);
139
140 /* @brief Resolve sensor-specific resources and return the fixed output format. */
141 [[nodiscard]] virtual SensorFormat InitSensor(
142 SensorScope const& scope,
143 superdex::Error& error) = 0;
144
145 /* @brief Reset sensor-specific state. Stateless sensors implement an explicit no-op. */
146 virtual void ResetSensor() = 0;
147
148 [[nodiscard]] Span<SensorBase const* const> Inputs() const {
149 return _inputs;
150 }
151
152 /* @brief The node name of the first graph that holds this sensor; empty outside any graph. */
153 [[nodiscard]] std::string_view GraphName() const {
154 return {_graphName.c_str(), _graphName.size()};
155 }
156
157 /* @brief The seed of the sensor's random streams: SetEpisodeSeed's, else @p paramsSeed. */
158 [[nodiscard]] uint64_t EpisodeSeed(uint64_t paramsSeed) const {
159 return _episodeSeed.value_or(paramsSeed);
160 }
161
162 /* @brief Complete the sensor's write stroke by copying one full sample into owned storage. */
163 bool PublishSample(
164 StepTime const& now,
165 Span<float const> sample,
166 superdex::Error& error,
167 SensorSample const* source = nullptr);
168
169 /* Sensor pose relative to its parent frame; see GetParentFromSensor(). */
170 TransformRT _parentFromSensor;
171
172 ~SensorBase() override;
173
174 private:
175 friend class SensorGraph;
176 friend class RoboticsContext;
177
178 void PrepareOutput(SensorFormat format, superdex::Error& error);
179 void ClearOutput();
180
181 int32_t _graphBorrowCount = 0;
182 DynamicString _graphName;
183 std::optional<uint64_t> _episodeSeed;
184 SensorFormat _format;
185 DynamicArray<SensorBase const*> _inputs;
186 DynamicArray<float> _output;
187 SensorSample _latest;
188};

190template <typename T>
191struct SensorMetadataKey;
192
193/* @brief Query optional typed sensor metadata. The returned object remains producer-owned and is
194 * valid only while the sensor's current initialization remains live. */
195template <typename T>
196[[nodiscard]] T const* TryGetSensorMetadata(SensorBase const& sensor) {
197 Span<std::byte const> const bytes = sensor.TryGetMetadata(SensorMetadataKey<T>::Key);
198 if (bytes.empty() || bytes.size() != sizeof(T)) {
199 return nullptr;
200 }
201 auto const address = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(bytes.data());
202 if (address % alignof(T) != 0) {
203 return nullptr;
204 }
205 // TryGetMetadata returns the byte view of an already-live T owned by the producer. This recovers
206 // that original pointer; it does not materialize T from copied object representation, so metadata
207 // may contain owning strings and other non-trivially-copyable members.
208 return reinterpret_cast<T const*>(bytes.data());
209}
